title: SHABBIR KAHAN HAI MERA SHABBIR KAHAN HAI
body:
Zehra ki Sada thi Mera Dilgeer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Is dasht me Dhoondu'n Main kahan Apne Pisar ko
Rasta bhi sujhaai nahi'n deta hai nazar ko
Kab tak phiru'n thaame huwe Main Apne jigar ko
Koi to bataade Shahe Dilgeer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar peet'ti Rothi rahi maqtal me Main Dukhiya
Zalim ne Mere Lal pa kuch rehm na khaya
Sar Tan se juda kar diya Bekas ka Khudaya
Wo khoon me doobi hui tasweer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe hain Shaheedo'n ke yu'n maidaan me saare
Jis tarha se bikhre huwe Qur'an ke Paare
Zalim ne kiye Qalbo Jigar chaak Hamaare
Wo bolte Qur'an ki Tafseer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lut jaaungi is tarha ye soncha bhi nahi'n tha
Aankhon ke Mere saamne chhaya hai andhera
Tha Noor jo aankhon ka hua door wo aisa
Sar ta ba qadam paikare tanweer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Jism bhi paamaal Tera aye MereDilbar
Rote hain sabhi hooro malak arshe bari'n par
Hai khaak pa begoro kafan Sibte Payambar
Urya'n hai Badan Chaadare Tatheer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti thi Mujahid yehi bas Maadare Shabbir
Jaau'n Main kahan haay Khuda kya karu'n Tadbeer
Karbal me luti hai Meri Duniya Meri jaagir
Akbar hai kahan haay wo Besheer kahan hai
<<MINI>>
Shabbir kahan hai Mera Shabbir kahan hai
author: Mujahid Hussain
